title: THE BELT LINES READ LIKE A SHOOTER HUD
why: His order of 2026-10-09: every line the player reads in a raid reads like Call of Duty, Fortnite or ARC Raiders, a short capital headline and only when needed a short detail. The review of the four-gun belt (build 3) found the belt still talking in sentences. Now: GUN SLOT 2 EMPTY (was No second weapon. Drag one here to carry it.); SHOTGUN ON KEY 3 and STIM INJECTOR ON KEY 9 (was Shotgun to belt slot 3.); GUN SLOTS FULL with MARKSMAN RIFLE IN BACKPACK under it (was one long line); EMPTY SLOT with PRESS 1 FOR YOUR GUN under it; GUNS ONLY with KEY 3 under it; GUN KEYS ONLY with DRAG OFF BELT TO STOW under it; a gun key trade SHOTGUN ON KEY 3 with MEDKIT ON KEY 1 under it; SHOTGUN UP with RIFLE IN BACKPACK, KEY 1 under it; CANNOT EQUIP; SHOTGUN STOWED for a gun that went to the free slot, with the key that swaps to it under it when it was found; ISSUED KIT with CANNOT STOW under it; and the revive pay, which still said he puts his gun in your hands although it goes into the backpack, now says SHOTGUN RECEIVED with its key or IN BACKPACK under it. Nothing the lines describe changed.
now: The tactical belt lines now read like a shooter HUD: GUN SLOT 2 EMPTY, SHOTGUN ON KEY 3, GUN SLOTS FULL, EMPTY SLOT, SHOTGUN STOWED.
